textos.texto: Ana wakes up at six and she gets up quickly. First she has a shower and she brushes her teeth. Then she gets dressed and she makes the bed. She has breakfast and she goes to work. She arrives at eight, she starts and she finishes at two. Then she comes back and she has lunch. In the afternoon she does her homework and she studies. Sometimes she takes a nap, but not every day. In the evening she cooks the dinner and she cleans. Then she listens to music or she reads. On Saturday she goes out with her friends and they walk in the city. She never runs in the morning, but she often walks. That day she goes to bed very late and she sleeps eight hours, and on Sunday she rests. This is her routine.

Ana takes a nap every day.

Ana runs in the morning.

textos.texto: Paul wakes up late, at nine o'clock, because he works in the evening. He does not get up quickly: first he rests in bed for half an hour. Then he showers, he brushes his teeth and he gets dressed. He never makes the bed! He has breakfast at ten, and after he reads. In the morning he cleans and he walks in the city. He has lunch at noon with Laura. In the afternoon he does his homework, and sometimes he takes a nap. He goes to work at five and he finishes at midnight. He comes back and he has dinner very late. Then he listens to music. He goes to bed at two. Is this a good routine? No! says Ana. But Paul runs every Sunday and he is never tired.

textos.titulo: La rutina del fin de semana
textos.texto: On Saturday Ana does not go to work. She wakes up late, at nine, and she rests in bed. Then she gets up, she has a shower and she brushes her teeth. She does not make the bed on Saturday! She has breakfast very late and she reads. In the morning she cleans. At noon she has lunch with Laura and after they walk in the city. In the afternoon she takes a nap, and then she does her homework: she studies every day, also on Saturday. In the evening she cooks and she listens to music. She goes out with her friends and she comes back very late. On Sunday she sleeps and she rests. That is her weekend routine.

textos.texto: Ana wakes up at six and Paul wakes up at nine. Ana gets up quickly, but Paul rests in bed for half an hour. Ana has breakfast at half past six and she goes to work at seven. She arrives at eight and she finishes at two. Paul goes to work at five in the afternoon and he finishes at midnight. Ana has lunch at noon and Paul has lunch with Laura. In the afternoon Ana does her homework and Paul takes a nap. In the evening Ana cooks and cleans; Paul comes back very late and he has dinner. Ana goes to bed at eleven and Paul goes to bed at two. Ana runs on Sunday and Paul walks every day.

textos.texto: Marie wakes up at seven and she gets up quickly. First she has a shower and she brushes her teeth. Then she gets dressed and she makes the bed: every day, also on the weekend. She has breakfast at half past seven and she goes to work. She arrives at nine and she finishes at five. At noon she has lunch. In the afternoon she comes back and she rests: sometimes she takes a nap, but not every day. Then she does her homework and she studies. In the evening she cooks the dinner and she cleans. She listens to music or she reads. She never runs, but she walks every day. She goes to bed at eleven and she sleeps eight hours. That is her routine.
